== Card credits ==
Brian Hollingworth is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of two cards.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards are in [[Virtual Block 1]] and [[Virtual Block 2]]. The occasions named in the concept credits date from 2005.
Two cards in all (Concept: 2).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Brian Hollingworth|Brian Hollingworth]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>

* "Betashyyykshire V-Lite 2005": [[Gravel Storm (V)]]
* "NYC Mini-Open 2005": [[Encampment (V)|&lt;&gt;Encampment (V)]]
